cve_details.description:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

net: skbuff: preserve shared-frag marker during coalescing

skb_try_coalesce() can attach paged frags from @from to @to.  If @from
has SKBFL_SHARED_FRAG set, the resulting @to skb can contain the same
externally-owned or page-cache-backed frags, but the shared-frag marker
is currently lost.

That breaks the invariant relied on by later in-place writers.  In
particular, ESP input checks skb_has_shared_frag() before deciding

cve_details.description: SolarWinds Serv-U is affected by a privilege escalation vulnerability that, when exploited, can allow a domain administrator to access files that otherwise would require elevated privileges. The risk is lower for Windows installations.

Solarwinds Serv-U is affected by a privilege escalation vulnerability that, when exploited, could lead to the escalation of privileges to root for Linux installations. The risk is lower for Windows installations.

SolarWinds Serv-U is affected by an Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) vulnerability that allows a domain group administrator to bypass restrictions and escalate privileges to the server administrator level. The risk is lower for Windows installations.

cve_details.description:
A stack-based buffer overflow in an unauthenticated CGI handler of the
Danfoss AK-SM 8xxA Series controller allows remote attackers to send specially
crafted HTTP/S POST requests, leading to memory corruption, webserver restart
and hypothetically potential arbitrary code execution with webserver privileges.
Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.
